name: two-people-one-first-name
description: Two Sams: only their full names say who's who.
lines: Sam Patel, can you give the finance update first?
Yes. We're under budget by about three percent, mostly because two hires slipped.
Thanks. And Sam Okafor, how's the hiring going?
Slowly, we've had fewer applicants than we hoped for the senior roles.
